notableTimingDetail: Unlike R0001, no reconnect (no 4th replicaId allocated) occurred before this crash — sessions 1/2/3 stayed connected throughout. This is a meaningful data point for root-causing: it shows the canary can fire WITHOUT a mid-session reconnect having happened first, which narrows the hypothesis space away from 'only the reconnect/re-seed path is buggy' and back toward something in real concurrent-delivery timing under latency more generally (see also R0004, also no-reconnect-required for its divergence... verify against R0004's log before treating this as settled).
reproducibilityCaveat: Same Rule 3 deviation as R0001: raw operationLog for this occurrence was not persisted before teardown. Record is full-fidelity for provenance/pattern-matching, not a byte-exact reproducer.
status: RESOLVED (test-infrastructure, not product) — see tests/regression/README.md's FINAL RESOLUTION section, 2026-08-31.
